# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform refresh**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and expands supported platform tooling. This release restores Linux system-font discovery without bundled dependencies, refreshes desktop rendering samples, and aligns native assets with upcoming .NET releases.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Desktop and WebAssembly platform support refreshed** — Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering and pixel scaling, aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 previews, and updates Tizen builds to GCC 14.2. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249), [#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
